qolbundle.gui.title: QoL Bundle
qolbundle.module.durability_alert.name: Durability Alert
qolbundle.module.durability_alert.desc: Red screen edges and a sound when a tool or armor piece is about to break.

qolbundle.module.fullbright.desc: See in the dark as if you had Night Vision, without the potion.
qolbundle.module.info_hud.name: Info HUD
qolbundle.module.info_hud.desc: Coordinates, facing, FPS and time in a screen corner.
qolbundle.module.armor_hud.name: Armor Durability HUD
qolbundle.module.armor_hud.desc: Worn armor and held tools with their remaining durability.
qolbundle.module.break_progress.name: Break Progress
qolbundle.module.break_progress.desc: Shows how far the block you are mining is broken, and the time left.

qolbundle.module.respawn_point.hud.warni: Your bed is gone. Sleep in a bed again!
Your respawn anchor is gone or empty.
